baseline.model:
---- MODULE LocalLibraryMigration ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

\* ItemKeys lists local items in createdAt order; each key is <<kind, name>>.
\* Calls are sequential browser loads; API outcomes and flag writes may fail.
\* This is the no-loss contract chosen in F1/A, not a claim that the current
\* function conforms: its premature completion/deletion paths are bugs below.
\* shared records only server keys matching an original local item's exact
\* <<kind, name>>; seen is the same projection of one listHistory snapshot.
\* Other server entries (including same-kind/different-name and
\* different-kind/same-name entries) project away: neither counts as a copy.
\* This observational projection preserves every migration decision while
\* avoiding independent state copies for irrelevant server entries.
\* localItems records the original database; the function never removes one row.
\* deleteIssued records deleteDatabase invocation, not asynchronous completion.
\* writes counts attempted uploads, marker writes, and deletion requests.
\* retryItems records first-load failures still absent from the shared store.
\* No fairness is assumed for another browser load or a successful I/O response.
CONSTANTS ItemCount, MaxLoads, FirstKind, SecondKind, FirstName, SecondName

ItemKeys == [i \in 1..ItemCount |->
    <<IF i = 1 THEN FirstKind ELSE SecondKind, FirstName>>]

ServerKeys == {<<FirstKind, FirstName>>, <<SecondKind, FirstName>>,
    <<FirstKind, SecondName>>}
VARIABLES storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems

vars == <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

Items == 1..ItemCount

LocalKeys == {ItemKeys[i] : i \in localItems}

Phases == {"idle", "flag", "open", "metadata", "list", "scan", "read",
    "upload", "mark", "markEmpty", "delete", "return"}

WriteCounts == [upload : 0..(ItemCount * MaxLoads),
    mark : 0..MaxLoads, delete : 0..MaxLoads]

ZeroWrites == [upload |-> 0, mark |-> 0, delete |-> 0]

Current == CHOOSE i \in todo : \A j \in todo : i <= j

Missing == {i \in localItems : ItemKeys[i] \notin shared}

AllShared == Missing = {}

TypeOK ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in SUBSET Items
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deleteIssued \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ loads \in 0..MaxLoads
    /\ todo \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ seen \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ unreadable \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ failed \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ metadataOK \in BOOLEAN
    /\ writes \in WriteCounts
    /\ entryDone \in BOOLEAN
    /\ entryWrites \in WriteCounts
    /\ retryItems \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ (phase \in {"read", "upload"} => todo # {})

DeleteOnlyWhenShared == deleteIssued => AllShared

CompletionRequiresAllShared == flag => AllShared

CompletedLoadsQuiet == entryDone => writes = entryWrites

NoStorageWork == ~storage => writes = ZeroWrites

NoAbsentLibraryCopy ==
    ~oldDatabase => (writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0)

UploadOnlyNewKeys ==
    phase \in {"read", "upload"} => ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen

CopiedAndCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ AllShared
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload > 0

AlreadySharedCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload = 0

UnreadableRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ unreadable \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedUploadRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ failed \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedItemRetried ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ loads = 2
    /\ Current \in retryItems

LaterLoadQuiet ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 2 /\ entryDone
    /\ writes = entryWrites

AbsentLibrarySkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~oldDatabase /\ flag
    /\ writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0

AbsentStorageSkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~storage
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites

EmptyLibraryCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ oldDatabase /\ localItems = {}
    /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ writes.upload = 0

MetadataFailureRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ ~metadataOK /\ Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

Init ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in {1..n : n \in 0..ItemCount}
    /\ (~oldDatabase => localItems = {})
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag = FALSE /\ deleteIssued = FALSE
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 0
    /\ todo = {} /\ seen = {} /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
    /\ metadataOK = TRUE
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites /\ entryDone = FALSE /\ entryWrites = ZeroWrites
    /\ retryItems = {}

StartLoad ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads < MaxLoads
    /\ loads' = loads + 1 /\ phase' = "flag"
    /\ entryDone' = flag /\ entryWrites' = writes
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK, writes, retryItems>>

ReadFlag ==
    /\ phase = "flag"
    /\ phase' = IF ~storage \/ flag THEN "return" ELSE "open"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ seen' = {} /\ unreadable' = {} /\ failed' = {}
    /\ metadataOK' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

NoDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ ~oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "markEmpty"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenError ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenThrows ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadMetadata ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = localItems /\ metadataOK' = TRUE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MetadataError ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ metadataOK' = FALSE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListShared ==
    /\ phase = "list"
    /\ seen' = shared /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListError ==
    /\ phase = "list" /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

SkipExisting ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \in seen
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

StartRead ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen
    /\ phase' = "read"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadBytes ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ phase' = "upload"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

BytesUnavailable ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ unreadable' = unreadable \union {Current}
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadSuccess ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ shared' = shared \union {ItemKeys[Current]}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ failed' = failed \union {Current}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

FinishItems ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {}
    /\ phase' = IF metadataOK /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
        THEN "mark" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MarkerWritten ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ flag' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = IF phase = "mark" /\ failed = {} THEN "delete" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MarkerError ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1] /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

DeleteDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "delete"
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.delete = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReturnFromLoad ==
    /\ phase = "return" /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ retryItems' = IF loads = 1
        THEN (unreadable \union failed) \intersect Missing ELSE retryItems
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites>>

Idle == phase = "idle" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ StartLoad \/ ReadFlag \/ OpenDatabase \/ NoDatabase \/ OpenError \/ OpenThrows
    \/ ReadMetadata \/ MetadataError \/ ListShared \/ ListError
    \/ SkipExisting \/ StartRead \/ ReadBytes \/ BytesUnavailable
    \/ UploadSuccess \/ UploadFailure \/ FinishItems
    \/ MarkerWritten \/ MarkerError \/ DeleteDatabase \/ ReturnFromLoad \/ Idle

DeleteIncomplete ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ ~AllShared
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.delete = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

CompleteDespiteUnreadableBytes ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ unreadable \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ phase' = "mark"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

CompleteDespiteUploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ failed \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ phase' = "mark"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

WriteAfterCompletion ==
    /\ phase = "flag" /\ entryDone /\ writes.mark < MaxLoads
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

statements.name: DeleteOnlyWhenShared
statements.says: Deletion of the old database is requested only when every original local item is present in the shared library under the same kind and name.

statements.says: The completion flag is never set while any original local item is still absent from the shared library.

statements.name: CompletedLoadsQuiet
statements.says: A load that starts with the completion flag makes no upload, flag-write, or database-deletion attempt.

statements.name: NoStorageWork
statements.says: When reading local storage is unavailable, migration makes no upload, flag-write, or database-deletion attempt.

statements.name: NoAbsentLibraryCopy
statements.says: A browser with no old database uploads no items and requests no database deletion.

statements.name: UploadOnlyNewKeys
statements.says: An item is read for upload only if the shared-library listing lacks its exact kind and name.

statements.name: TypeOK
statements.says: All stored values, migration phases, item sets, and observed operation counts stay within their declared types and bounds.

statements.name: CopiedAndCompleted
statements.says: Migration can upload local items, mark completion, and request deletion after every local item is shared.

statements.name: AlreadySharedCompleted
statements.says: Migration can finish without uploads when every local item already exists under its kind and name.

statements.name: LaterLoadQuiet
statements.says: A second load after completion can return without making any further writes.

statements.name: AbsentLibrarySkipped
statements.says: A load with no old database can record completion without uploading or deleting anything.

statements.name: AbsentStorageSkipped
statements.says: A load without readable local storage can return without writing anything.

statements.name: EmptyLibraryCompleted
statements.says: An existing empty local database can be marked complete and scheduled for deletion without uploads.

statements.name: UnreadableRetained
statements.says: An item with unreadable bytes can remain local with migration still eligible for a later load.

statements.name: FailedUploadRetained
statements.says: An item whose upload failed can remain local with migration still eligible for a later load.

statements.name: FailedItemRetried
statements.says: A second load can attempt to read an item left uncopied by a first-load read or upload failure.

statements.name: MetadataFailureRetained
statements.says: A metadata-read failure can leave an incomplete local library intact and unmarked for a later load.

statements.name: DeleteIncomplete
statements.says: Migration requests deletion while at least one local item has no shared copy.

statements.name: CompleteDespiteUnreadableBytes
statements.says: Migration proceeds to mark completion after silently skipping an unreadable item that has no shared copy.

statements.name: CompleteDespiteUploadFailure
statements.says: Migration proceeds to mark completion even though an upload failed and the item is still absent from the shared library.

statements.name: WriteAfterCompletion
statements.says: A later load writes the completion flag again despite finding it already set.

proposal.module_text:
---- MODULE LocalLibraryMigration ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

\* Scope: one original local item and two sequential browser loads.
\* Items is a singleton of exact (kind, name) identities. Unrelated server
\* entries project away; sharing just a kind or just a name is not a match.
\* local is the original local inventory, not the asynchronously deleted DB.
\* deleteIssued observes deleteDatabase invocation, not deletion completion;
\* until that invocation the function never removes a local row.
\* shared records matching server items; external edits and concurrent loads
\* are outside this bounded scenario, as in the captured draft.
\* effects records this load's upload, flag-write and deletion attempts.
\* firstFailure is a history observation used only to witness later retries.
\* Request success supplies a result but never settles either read promise:
\* only transaction completion advances it; abort/request error rejects it.
\* Synchronous setup errors take the same rejection path. Events after a
\* settled promise, and waiting for external events, are observational stutters.
\* No fairness promises another browser load or a successful I/O response.
CONSTANTS Items, MaxLoads
VARIABLES storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen,
    deleteIssued, phase, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure

vars == <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen,
    deleteIssued, phase, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

Phases == {"idle", "flag", "open", "metadata", "metadataResult", "list",
    "read", "readResult", "upload", "mark", "markEmpty", "closeRead",
    "closeUpload", "closeCheck", "closeSuccess", "delete", "return"}

AllShared == local \subseteq shared

TypeOK ==
    /\ Cardinality(Items) = 1
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ local \in SUBSET Items /\ shared \in SUBSET local
    /\ readable \in BOOLEAN /\ flag \in BOOLEAN /\ dbOpen \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deleteIssued \in BOOLEAN /\ entryDone \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases /\ loads \in 0..MaxLoads
    /\ effects \in SUBSET {"upload", "mark", "delete"}
    /\ firstFailure \in {"none", "bytes", "upload"}
    /\ (~oldDatabase => local = {})

DeleteOnlyWhenShared == deleteIssued => AllShared

CompletionRequiresAllShared ==
    ~AllShared => (~flag /\ ~deleteIssued)

CompletedLoadsQuiet ==
    entryDone => (flag /\ effects = {} /\ ~dbOpen
        /\ phase \in {"flag", "return", "idle"})

NoLocalWork ==
    /\ (~storage => (effects = {} /\ ~dbOpen /\ ~deleteIssued))
    /\ (~oldDatabase =>
        (effects \subseteq {"mark"} /\ ~dbOpen /\ ~deleteIssued))

ClosedDatabase == phase \in {"idle", "return", "delete"} => ~dbOpen

CopiedAndCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ AllShared
    /\ local # {} /\ "upload" \in effects

UnreadableKeptAndRetried ==
    /\ loads = 2 /\ firstFailure = "bytes" /\ phase = "read"
    /\ ~AllShared /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued /\ dbOpen

FailedUploadKeptAndRetried ==
    /\ loads = 2 /\ firstFailure = "upload" /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ ~AllShared /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued /\ dbOpen

AbsentStorageSkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~storage
    /\ effects = {} /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued /\ ~dbOpen

Init ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ local \in SUBSET Items /\ (~oldDatabase => local = {})
    /\ shared \in SUBSET local
    /\ readable = FALSE /\ flag = FALSE /\ dbOpen = FALSE
    /\ deleteIssued = FALSE /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 0
    /\ effects = {} /\ entryDone = FALSE /\ firstFailure = "none"

StartLoad ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ loads < MaxLoads
    /\ loads' = loads + 1
    /\ phase' = "flag"
    /\ entryDone' = flag
    /\ effects' = {}
    /\ readable' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, firstFailure>>

ReadFlag ==
    /\ phase = "flag"
    /\ phase' = IF ~storage \/ flag THEN "return" ELSE "open"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

OpenDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ oldDatabase
    /\ dbOpen' = TRUE
    /\ phase' = "metadata"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

NoDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ ~oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "markEmpty"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

OpenError ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MetadataRequestSuccess ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ phase' = "metadataResult"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MetadataComplete ==
    /\ phase = "metadataResult"
    /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MetadataAbort ==
    /\ phase \in {"metadata", "metadataResult"}
    /\ phase' = "closeCheck"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MetadataRequestError ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ phase' = "closeCheck"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MetadataSetupError ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ phase' = "closeCheck"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

ListShared ==
    /\ phase = "list"
    /\ phase' = IF AllShared THEN "mark" ELSE "read"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

ListError ==
    /\ phase = "list"
    /\ phase' = "closeCheck"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

BytesRequestSuccess(readableResult) ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ phase' = "readResult"
    /\ readable' = readableResult
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

BytesComplete ==
    /\ phase = "readResult"
    /\ readable
    /\ phase' = "upload"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MissingBlob ==
    /\ phase = "readResult"
    /\ ~readable
    /\ phase' = "closeRead"
    /\ firstFailure' = IF loads = 1 THEN "bytes" ELSE firstFailure
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone>>

BytesAbort ==
    /\ phase \in {"read", "readResult"}
    /\ phase' = "closeRead"
    /\ firstFailure' = IF loads = 1 THEN "bytes" ELSE firstFailure
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone>>

BytesRequestError ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ phase' = "closeRead"
    /\ firstFailure' = IF loads = 1 THEN "bytes" ELSE firstFailure
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone>>

BytesSetupError ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ phase' = "closeRead"
    /\ firstFailure' = IF loads = 1 THEN "bytes" ELSE firstFailure
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone>>

UploadSuccess ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ shared' = local
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"upload"}
    /\ phase' = "mark"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, entryDone, firstFailure>>

UploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"upload"}
    /\ phase' = "closeUpload"
    /\ firstFailure' = IF loads = 1 THEN "upload" ELSE firstFailure
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, entryDone>>

MarkerWritten ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ flag' = TRUE
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"mark"}
    /\ phase' = IF phase = "mark" THEN "closeSuccess" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MarkerError ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"mark"}

CloseDatabase ==
    /\ phase \in {"closeRead", "closeUpload", "closeCheck", "closeSuccess"}

    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, phase, loads, entryDone, firstFailure>>

CompleteDespiteUnreadableBytes ==
    /\ phase = "closeRead"
    /\ ~AllShared
    /\ flag' = TRUE
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"mark"}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, dbOpen, deleteIssued, phase, loads, entryDone, firstFailure>>

    /\ phase = "closeUpload"
    /\ ~AllShared
    /\ flag' = TRUE
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"mark"}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, dbOpen, deleteIssued, phase, loads, entryDone, firstFailure>>

rules.name: Spec
rules.says: Each browser load follows the modeled migration steps within the checked bounds.

rules.name: DeleteOnlyWhenShared
rules.says: Deletion of the old database is requested only when every original local item is present in the shared library under the same kind and name.

rules.name: CompletionRequiresAllShared
rules.says: An item still missing from the shared library stays local with the completion flag clear, so a later load can retry it.

rules.name: CompletedLoadsQuiet
rules.says: A load that starts with the completion flag returns without opening the database or attempting an upload, flag write, or deletion.

rules.name: NoLocalWork
rules.says: Without an old library no items are uploaded or deleted, and without readable local storage migration makes no writes.

rules.name: ClosedDatabase
rules.says: The database is closed before migration returns or requests deletion.

rules.name: TypeOK
rules.says: All item locations, flags, read results, phases, and load observations stay within their declared types and bounds.

rules.name: CopiedAndCompleted
rules.says: Migration can upload the item, mark completion, close the database, and request deletion.

rules.name: UnreadableKeptAndRetried
rules.says: An item with unreadable bytes can stay local and be read again on the second load.

rules.name: FailedUploadKeptAndRetried
rules.says: An item whose upload failed can stay local and reach another upload attempt on the second load.

rules.name: AbsentStorageSkipped
rules.says: A load without readable local storage can return without opening the database or writing anything.

rules.name: DeleteIncomplete
rules.says: Migration requests deletion after a read or upload failure while the item still has no shared copy.

rules.name: CompleteDespiteUnreadableBytes
rules.says: Migration marks completion after failing to read an item that has no shared copy.

rules.name: CompleteDespiteUploadFailure
rules.says: Migration marks completion after an upload failed and left the item without a shared copy.

baseline.model:
---- MODULE LocalLibraryMigration ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

\* ItemKeys lists local items in createdAt order; each key is <<kind, name>>.
\* Calls are sequential browser loads; API outcomes and flag writes may fail.
\* This is the no-loss contract chosen in F1/A, not a claim that the current
\* function conforms: its premature completion/deletion paths are bugs below.
\* shared records only server keys matching an original local item's exact
\* <<kind, name>>; seen is the same projection of one listHistory snapshot.
\* Other server entries (including same-kind/different-name and
\* different-kind/same-name entries) project away: neither counts as a copy.
\* This observational projection preserves every migration decision while
\* avoiding independent state copies for irrelevant server entries.
\* localItems records the original database; the function never removes one row.
\* deleteIssued records deleteDatabase invocation, not asynchronous completion.
\* writes counts attempted uploads, marker writes, and deletion requests.
\* retryItems records first-load failures still absent from the shared store.
\* No fairness is assumed for another browser load or a successful I/O response.
CONSTANTS ItemCount, MaxLoads, FirstKind, SecondKind, FirstName, SecondName

ItemKeys == [i \in 1..ItemCount |->
    <<IF i = 1 THEN FirstKind ELSE SecondKind, FirstName>>]

ServerKeys == {<<FirstKind, FirstName>>, <<SecondKind, FirstName>>,
    <<FirstKind, SecondName>>}
VARIABLES storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems

vars == <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

Items == 1..ItemCount

LocalKeys == {ItemKeys[i] : i \in localItems}

Phases == {"idle", "flag", "open", "metadata", "list", "scan", "read",
    "upload", "mark", "markEmpty", "delete", "return"}

WriteCounts == [upload : 0..(ItemCount * MaxLoads),
    mark : 0..MaxLoads, delete : 0..MaxLoads]

ZeroWrites == [upload |-> 0, mark |-> 0, delete |-> 0]

Current == CHOOSE i \in todo : \A j \in todo : i <= j

Missing == {i \in localItems : ItemKeys[i] \notin shared}

AllShared == Missing = {}

TypeOK ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in SUBSET Items
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deleteIssued \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ loads \in 0..MaxLoads
    /\ todo \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ seen \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ unreadable \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ failed \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ metadataOK \in BOOLEAN
    /\ writes \in WriteCounts
    /\ entryDone \in BOOLEAN
    /\ entryWrites \in WriteCounts
    /\ retryItems \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ (phase \in {"read", "upload"} => todo # {})

DeleteOnlyWhenShared == deleteIssued => AllShared

CompletionRequiresAllShared == flag => AllShared

CompletedLoadsQuiet == entryDone => writes = entryWrites

NoStorageWork == ~storage => writes = ZeroWrites

NoAbsentLibraryCopy ==
    ~oldDatabase => (writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0)

UploadOnlyNewKeys ==
    phase \in {"read", "upload"} => ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen

CopiedAndCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ AllShared
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload > 0

AlreadySharedCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload = 0

UnreadableRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ unreadable \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedUploadRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ failed \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedItemRetried ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ loads = 2
    /\ Current \in retryItems

LaterLoadQuiet ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 2 /\ entryDone
    /\ writes = entryWrites

AbsentLibrarySkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~oldDatabase /\ flag
    /\ writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0

AbsentStorageSkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~storage
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites

EmptyLibraryCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ oldDatabase /\ localItems = {}
    /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ writes.upload = 0

MetadataFailureRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ ~metadataOK /\ Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

Init ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in {1..n : n \in 0..ItemCount}
    /\ (~oldDatabase => localItems = {})
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag = FALSE /\ deleteIssued = FALSE
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 0
    /\ todo = {} /\ seen = {} /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
    /\ metadataOK = TRUE
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites /\ entryDone = FALSE /\ entryWrites = ZeroWrites
    /\ retryItems = {}

StartLoad ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads < MaxLoads
    /\ loads' = loads + 1 /\ phase' = "flag"
    /\ entryDone' = flag /\ entryWrites' = writes
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK, writes, retryItems>>

ReadFlag ==
    /\ phase = "flag"
    /\ phase' = IF ~storage \/ flag THEN "return" ELSE "open"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ seen' = {} /\ unreadable' = {} /\ failed' = {}
    /\ metadataOK' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

NoDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ ~oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "markEmpty"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenError ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenThrows ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadMetadata ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = localItems /\ metadataOK' = TRUE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MetadataError ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ metadataOK' = FALSE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListShared ==
    /\ phase = "list"
    /\ seen' = shared /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListError ==
    /\ phase = "list" /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

SkipExisting ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \in seen
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

StartRead ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen
    /\ phase' = "read"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadBytes ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ phase' = "upload"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

BytesUnavailable ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ unreadable' = unreadable \union {Current}
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadSuccess ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ shared' = shared \union {ItemKeys[Current]}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ failed' = failed \union {Current}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

FinishItems ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {}
    /\ phase' = IF metadataOK /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
        THEN "mark" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MarkerWritten ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ flag' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = IF phase = "mark" /\ failed = {} THEN "delete" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MarkerError ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1] /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

DeleteDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "delete"
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.delete = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReturnFromLoad ==
    /\ phase = "return" /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ retryItems' = IF loads = 1
        THEN (unreadable \union failed) \intersect Missing ELSE retryItems
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites>>

Idle == phase = "idle" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ StartLoad \/ ReadFlag \/ OpenDatabase \/ NoDatabase \/ OpenError \/ OpenThrows
    \/ ReadMetadata \/ MetadataError \/ ListShared \/ ListError
    \/ SkipExisting \/ StartRead \/ ReadBytes \/ BytesUnavailable
    \/ UploadSuccess \/ UploadFailure \/ FinishItems
    \/ MarkerWritten \/ MarkerError \/ DeleteDatabase \/ ReturnFromLoad \/ Idle

DeleteIncomplete ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ ~AllShared
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.delete = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

CompleteDespiteUnreadableBytes ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ unreadable \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ phase' = "mark"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

CompleteDespiteUploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ failed \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ phase' = "mark"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

WriteAfterCompletion ==
    /\ phase = "flag" /\ entryDone /\ writes.mark < MaxLoads
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

candidate.model:
---- MODULE LocalLibraryMigration ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

\* Scope: one original local item and two sequential browser loads.
\* Items is a singleton of exact (kind, name) identities. Unrelated server
\* entries project away; sharing just a kind or just a name is not a match.
\* local is the original local inventory, not the asynchronously deleted DB.
\* deleteIssued observes deleteDatabase invocation, not deletion completion;
\* until that invocation the function never removes a local row.
\* shared records matching server items; external edits and concurrent loads
\* are outside this bounded scenario, as in the captured draft.
\* effects records this load's upload, flag-write and deletion attempts.
\* firstFailure is a history observation used only to witness later retries.
\* Request success supplies a result but never settles either read promise:
\* only transaction completion advances it; abort/request error rejects it.
\* Synchronous setup errors take the same rejection path. Events after a
\* settled promise, and waiting for external events, are observational stutters.
\* No fairness promises another browser load or a successful I/O response.
CONSTANTS Items, MaxLoads
VARIABLES storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen,
    deleteIssued, phase, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure

vars == <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen,
    deleteIssued, phase, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

Phases == {"idle", "flag", "open", "metadata", "metadataResult", "list",
    "read", "readResult", "upload", "mark", "markEmpty", "closeRead",
    "closeUpload", "closeCheck", "closeSuccess", "delete", "return"}

AllShared == local \subseteq shared

TypeOK ==
    /\ Cardinality(Items) = 1
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ local \in SUBSET Items /\ shared \in SUBSET local
    /\ readable \in BOOLEAN /\ flag \in BOOLEAN /\ dbOpen \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deleteIssued \in BOOLEAN /\ entryDone \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases /\ loads \in 0..MaxLoads
    /\ effects \in SUBSET {"upload", "mark", "delete"}
    /\ firstFailure \in {"none", "bytes", "upload"}
    /\ (~oldDatabase => local = {})

DeleteOnlyWhenShared == deleteIssued => AllShared

CompletionRequiresAllShared ==
    ~AllShared => (~flag /\ ~deleteIssued)

CompletedLoadsQuiet ==
    entryDone => (flag /\ effects = {} /\ ~dbOpen
        /\ phase \in {"flag", "return", "idle"})

NoLocalWork ==
    /\ (~storage => (effects = {} /\ ~dbOpen /\ ~deleteIssued))
    /\ (~oldDatabase =>
        (effects \subseteq {"mark"} /\ ~dbOpen /\ ~deleteIssued))

ClosedDatabase == phase \in {"idle", "return", "delete"} => ~dbOpen

CopiedAndCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ AllShared
    /\ local # {} /\ "upload" \in effects

UnreadableKeptAndRetried ==
    /\ loads = 2 /\ firstFailure = "bytes" /\ phase = "read"
    /\ ~AllShared /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued /\ dbOpen

FailedUploadKeptAndRetried ==
    /\ loads = 2 /\ firstFailure = "upload" /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ ~AllShared /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued /\ dbOpen

AbsentStorageSkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~storage
    /\ effects = {} /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued /\ ~dbOpen

Init ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ local \in SUBSET Items /\ (~oldDatabase => local = {})
    /\ shared \in SUBSET local
    /\ readable = FALSE /\ flag = FALSE /\ dbOpen = FALSE
    /\ deleteIssued = FALSE /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 0
    /\ effects = {} /\ entryDone = FALSE /\ firstFailure = "none"

StartLoad ==
    /\ phase = "idle"
    /\ loads < MaxLoads
    /\ loads' = loads + 1
    /\ phase' = "flag"
    /\ entryDone' = flag
    /\ effects' = {}
    /\ readable' = FALSE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, firstFailure>>

ReadFlag ==
    /\ phase = "flag"
    /\ phase' = IF ~storage \/ flag THEN "return" ELSE "open"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

OpenDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ oldDatabase
    /\ dbOpen' = TRUE
    /\ phase' = "metadata"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

NoDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ ~oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "markEmpty"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

OpenError ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MetadataRequestSuccess ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ phase' = "metadataResult"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MetadataComplete ==
    /\ phase = "metadataResult"
    /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MetadataAbort ==
    /\ phase \in {"metadata", "metadataResult"}
    /\ phase' = "closeCheck"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MetadataRequestError ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ phase' = "closeCheck"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MetadataSetupError ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ phase' = "closeCheck"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

ListShared ==
    /\ phase = "list"
    /\ phase' = IF AllShared THEN "mark" ELSE "read"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

ListError ==
    /\ phase = "list"
    /\ phase' = "closeCheck"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

BytesRequestSuccess(readableResult) ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ phase' = "readResult"
    /\ readable' = readableResult
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

BytesComplete ==
    /\ phase = "readResult"
    /\ readable
    /\ phase' = "upload"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MissingBlob ==
    /\ phase = "readResult"
    /\ ~readable
    /\ phase' = "closeRead"
    /\ firstFailure' = IF loads = 1 THEN "bytes" ELSE firstFailure
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone>>

BytesAbort ==
    /\ phase \in {"read", "readResult"}
    /\ phase' = "closeRead"
    /\ firstFailure' = IF loads = 1 THEN "bytes" ELSE firstFailure
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone>>

BytesRequestError ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ phase' = "closeRead"
    /\ firstFailure' = IF loads = 1 THEN "bytes" ELSE firstFailure
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone>>

BytesSetupError ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ phase' = "closeRead"
    /\ firstFailure' = IF loads = 1 THEN "bytes" ELSE firstFailure
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone>>

UploadSuccess ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ shared' = local
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"upload"}
    /\ phase' = "mark"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, entryDone, firstFailure>>

UploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"upload"}
    /\ phase' = "closeUpload"
    /\ firstFailure' = IF loads = 1 THEN "upload" ELSE firstFailure
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, entryDone>>

MarkerWritten ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ flag' = TRUE
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"mark"}
    /\ phase' = IF phase = "mark" THEN "closeSuccess" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, entryDone, firstFailure>>

MarkerError ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"mark"}
    /\ phase' = IF dbOpen THEN "closeCheck" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, entryDone, firstFailure>>

CloseDatabase ==
    /\ phase \in {"closeRead", "closeUpload", "closeCheck", "closeSuccess"}
    /\ dbOpen' = FALSE
    /\ phase' = IF phase = "closeSuccess" THEN "delete" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

DeleteDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "delete"
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"delete"}
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, loads, entryDone, firstFailure>>

ReturnFromLoad ==
    /\ phase = "return"
    /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, deleteIssued, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

Idle == phase = "idle" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ StartLoad \/ ReadFlag \/ OpenDatabase \/ NoDatabase \/ OpenError
    \/ MetadataRequestSuccess \/ MetadataComplete
    \/ MetadataAbort \/ MetadataRequestError \/ MetadataSetupError
    \/ ListShared \/ ListError
    \/ (\E readableResult \in BOOLEAN : BytesRequestSuccess(readableResult))
    \/ BytesComplete \/ MissingBlob
    \/ BytesAbort \/ BytesRequestError \/ BytesSetupError
    \/ UploadSuccess \/ UploadFailure \/ MarkerWritten \/ MarkerError
    \/ CloseDatabase \/ DeleteDatabase \/ ReturnFromLoad \/ Idle

\* Regression mutations are deliberately excluded from Next.
DeleteIncomplete ==
    /\ phase \in {"closeRead", "closeUpload", "closeCheck"}
    /\ ~AllShared
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"delete"}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen, phase, loads, entryDone, firstFailure>>

CompleteDespiteUnreadableBytes ==
    /\ phase = "closeRead"
    /\ ~AllShared
    /\ flag' = TRUE
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"mark"}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, dbOpen, deleteIssued, phase, loads, entryDone, firstFailure>>

CompleteDespiteUploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "closeUpload"
    /\ ~AllShared
    /\ flag' = TRUE
    /\ effects' = effects \union {"mark"}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, dbOpen, deleteIssued, phase, loads, entryDone, firstFailure>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

---- MODULE LocalLibraryMigration ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets

\* ItemKeys lists local items in createdAt order; each key is <<kind, name>>.
\* Calls are sequential browser loads; API outcomes and flag writes may fail.
\* This is the no-loss contract chosen in F1/A, not a claim that the current
\* function conforms: its premature completion/deletion paths are bugs below.
\* shared records only server keys matching an original local item's exact
\* <<kind, name>>; seen is the same projection of one listHistory snapshot.
\* Other server entries (including same-kind/different-name and
\* different-kind/same-name entries) project away: neither counts as a copy.
\* This observational projection preserves every migration decision while
\* avoiding independent state copies for irrelevant server entries.
\* localItems records the original database; the function never removes one row.
\* deleteIssued records deleteDatabase invocation, not asynchronous completion.
\* writes counts attempted uploads, marker writes, and deletion requests.
\* retryItems records first-load failures still absent from the shared store.
\* No fairness is assumed for another browser load or a successful I/O response.
CONSTANTS ItemCount, MaxLoads, FirstKind, SecondKind, FirstName, SecondName

ItemKeys == [i \in 1..ItemCount |->
    <<IF i = 1 THEN FirstKind ELSE SecondKind, FirstName>>]

ServerKeys == {<<FirstKind, FirstName>>, <<SecondKind, FirstName>>,
    <<FirstKind, SecondName>>}
VARIABLES storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems

vars == <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag, deleteIssued,
    phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
    writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

Items == 1..ItemCount

LocalKeys == {ItemKeys[i] : i \in localItems}

Phases == {"idle", "flag", "open", "metadata", "list", "scan", "read",
    "upload", "mark", "markEmpty", "delete", "return"}

WriteCounts == [upload : 0..(ItemCount * MaxLoads),
    mark : 0..MaxLoads, delete : 0..MaxLoads]

ZeroWrites == [upload |-> 0, mark |-> 0, delete |-> 0]

Current == CHOOSE i \in todo : \A j \in todo : i <= j

Missing == {i \in localItems : ItemKeys[i] \notin shared}

AllShared == Missing = {}

TypeOK ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in SUBSET Items
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deleteIssued \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases
    /\ loads \in 0..MaxLoads
    /\ todo \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ seen \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ unreadable \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ failed \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ metadataOK \in BOOLEAN
    /\ writes \in WriteCounts
    /\ entryDone \in BOOLEAN
    /\ entryWrites \in WriteCounts
    /\ retryItems \in SUBSET localItems
    /\ (phase \in {"read", "upload"} => todo # {})

DeleteOnlyWhenShared == deleteIssued => AllShared

CompletionRequiresAllShared == flag => AllShared

CompletedLoadsQuiet == entryDone => writes = entryWrites

NoStorageWork == ~storage => writes = ZeroWrites

NoAbsentLibraryCopy ==
    ~oldDatabase => (writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0)

UploadOnlyNewKeys ==
    phase \in {"read", "upload"} => ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen

CopiedAndCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ AllShared
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload > 0

AlreadySharedCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ flag /\ deleteIssued
    /\ localItems # {} /\ writes.upload = 0

UnreadableRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ unreadable \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedUploadRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 1
    /\ failed \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

FailedItemRetried ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ loads = 2
    /\ Current \in retryItems

LaterLoadQuiet ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 2 /\ entryDone
    /\ writes = entryWrites

AbsentLibrarySkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~oldDatabase /\ flag
    /\ writes.upload = 0 /\ writes.delete = 0

AbsentStorageSkipped ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads > 0 /\ ~storage
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites

EmptyLibraryCompleted ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ oldDatabase /\ localItems = {}
    /\ flag /\ deleteIssued /\ writes.upload = 0

MetadataFailureRetained ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ ~metadataOK /\ Missing # {}
    /\ ~flag /\ ~deleteIssued

Init ==
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN
    /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ localItems \in {1..n : n \in 0..ItemCount}
    /\ (~oldDatabase => localItems = {})
    /\ shared \in SUBSET LocalKeys
    /\ flag = FALSE /\ deleteIssued = FALSE
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads = 0
    /\ todo = {} /\ seen = {} /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
    /\ metadataOK = TRUE
    /\ writes = ZeroWrites /\ entryDone = FALSE /\ entryWrites = ZeroWrites
    /\ retryItems = {}

StartLoad ==
    /\ phase = "idle" /\ loads < MaxLoads
    /\ loads' = loads + 1 /\ phase' = "flag"
    /\ entryDone' = flag /\ entryWrites' = writes
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK, writes, retryItems>>

ReadFlag ==
    /\ phase = "flag"
    /\ phase' = IF ~storage \/ flag THEN "return" ELSE "open"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ seen' = {} /\ unreadable' = {} /\ failed' = {}
    /\ metadataOK' = TRUE
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

NoDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ ~oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "markEmpty"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenError ==
    /\ phase = "open" /\ oldDatabase
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

OpenThrows ==
    /\ phase = "open"
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadMetadata ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = localItems /\ metadataOK' = TRUE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MetadataError ==
    /\ phase = "metadata"
    /\ todo' = {} /\ metadataOK' = FALSE /\ phase' = "list"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListShared ==
    /\ phase = "list"
    /\ seen' = shared /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ListError ==
    /\ phase = "list" /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

SkipExisting ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \in seen
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current}
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

StartRead ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo # {} /\ ItemKeys[Current] \notin seen
    /\ phase' = "read"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReadBytes ==
    /\ phase = "read" /\ phase' = "upload"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

BytesUnavailable ==
    /\ phase = "read"
    /\ unreadable' = unreadable \union {Current}
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadSuccess ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ shared' = shared \union {ItemKeys[Current]}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

UploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "upload"
    /\ failed' = failed \union {Current}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.upload = @ + 1]
    /\ todo' = todo \ {Current} /\ phase' = "scan"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, seen, unreadable, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

FinishItems ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {}
    /\ phase' = IF metadataOK /\ unreadable = {} /\ failed = {}
        THEN "mark" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MarkerWritten ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ flag' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = IF phase = "mark" /\ failed = {} THEN "delete" ELSE "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

MarkerError ==
    /\ phase \in {"mark", "markEmpty"}
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1] /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

DeleteDatabase ==
    /\ phase = "delete"
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.delete = @ + 1]
    /\ phase' = "return"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

ReturnFromLoad ==
    /\ phase = "return" /\ phase' = "idle"
    /\ retryItems' = IF loads = 1
        THEN (unreadable \union failed) \intersect Missing ELSE retryItems
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites>>

Idle == phase = "idle" /\ UNCHANGED vars

Next ==
    \/ StartLoad \/ ReadFlag \/ OpenDatabase \/ NoDatabase \/ OpenError \/ OpenThrows
    \/ ReadMetadata \/ MetadataError \/ ListShared \/ ListError
    \/ SkipExisting \/ StartRead \/ ReadBytes \/ BytesUnavailable
    \/ UploadSuccess \/ UploadFailure \/ FinishItems
    \/ MarkerWritten \/ MarkerError \/ DeleteDatabase \/ ReturnFromLoad \/ Idle

DeleteIncomplete ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ ~AllShared
    /\ deleteIssued' = TRUE /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.delete = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

CompleteDespiteUnreadableBytes ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ unreadable \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ phase' = "mark"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

CompleteDespiteUploadFailure ==
    /\ phase = "scan" /\ todo = {} /\ failed \intersect Missing # {}
    /\ phase' = "mark"
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        writes, entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

WriteAfterCompletion ==
    /\ phase = "flag" /\ entryDone /\ writes.mark < MaxLoads
    /\ writes' = [writes EXCEPT !.mark = @ + 1]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<storage, oldDatabase, localItems, shared, flag,
        deleteIssued, phase, loads, todo, seen, unreadable, failed, metadataOK,
        entryDone, entryWrites, retryItems>>

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
====

---- MODULE LocalLibraryMigration ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets

\* Scope: one original local item and two sequential browser loads.
\* Items is a singleton of exact (kind, name) identities. Unrelated server
\* entries project away; sharing just a kind or just a name is not a match.
\* local is the original local inventory, not the asynchronously deleted DB.
\* deleteIssued observes deleteDatabase invocation, not deletion completion;
\* until that invocation the function never removes a local row.
\* shared records matching server items; external edits and concurrent loads
\* are outside this bounded scenario, as in the captured draft.
\* effects records this load's upload, flag-write and deletion attempts.
\* firstFailure is a history observation used only to witness later retries.
\* Request success supplies a result but never settles either read promise:
\* only transaction completion advances it; abort/request error rejects it.
\* Synchronous setup errors take the same rejection path. Events after a
\* settled promise, and waiting for external events, are observational stutters.
\* No fairness promises another browser load or a successful I/O response.
CONSTANTS Items, MaxLoads
VARIABLES storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen,
    deleteIssued, phase, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure

vars == <<storage, oldDatabase, local, shared, readable, flag, dbOpen,
    deleteIssued, phase, loads, effects, entryDone, firstFailure>>

Phases == {"idle", "flag", "open", "metadata", "metadataResult", "list",
    "read", "readResult", "upload", "mark", "markEmpty", "closeRead",
    "closeUpload", "closeCheck", "closeSuccess", "delete", "return"}

AllShared == local \subseteq shared

TypeOK ==
    /\ Cardinality(Items) = 1
    /\ storage \in BOOLEAN /\ oldDatabase \in BOOLEAN
    /\ local \in SUBSET Items /\ shared \in SUBSET local
    /\ readable \in BOOLEAN /\ flag \in BOOLEAN /\ dbOpen \in BOOLEAN
    /\ deleteIssued \in BOOLEAN /\ entryDone \in BOOLEAN
    /\ phase \in Phases /\ loads \in 0..MaxLoads
    /\ effects \in SUBSET {"upload", "mark", "delete"}
    /\ firstFailure \in {"none", "bytes", "upload"}
    /\ (~oldDatabase => local = {})

DeleteOnlyWhenShared == deleteIssued => AllShared

CompletionRequiresAllShared ==
    ~AllShared => (~flag /\ ~deleteIssued)

CompletedLoadsQuiet ==
    entryDone => (flag /\ effects = {} /\ ~dbOpen
        /\ phase \in {"flag", "return", "idle"})

NoLocalWork ==
